about: Triad Drift ENG-38 cloud pass sounds (effects builder, Nov 14): the punch through the cloud deck and the wind under the planet glide. Original synthesis (scripts/td_synth.py), no samples; engineering fallbacks in the same family as Travel_DescentRoar. Nicholas's sound at the slot replaces them. db = level relative to the anchor (Lancer primary fire), mix-standard.md section 4. A sound with an empty slots list has no data slot yet: its asset path is handed to the code owner.

sounds.name: Travel_CloudPunch
sounds.note: ENG-38: the ship punches through the cloud deck (either direction). A muffled rush that swells, a soft air-pressure thump as the ship breaks through, then the sound opens up bright with a fading vapour hiss. Played by TDDescentSubsystem at the ship (DA_Travel_FX.CloudPunch), 3D.

sounds.name: Travel_GlideWind
sounds.note: ENG-38: the wind under the 8-10 s planet glide, rising as the descent roar thins. 2D mono loop: airy mid-high wind in slow gusts with a faint whistle, no low rumble (the roar owns the lows). Needs a slot whose volume T1 drives against the roar (CloudWisps plays its sound with no handle kept, so it would never stop).
